review.summary: Slice: rules, selectors, words. No regression against 2.1 found: the rules play as 2.1 did (re-run on fresh seeds, and the equivalence tool does notice planted differences), every run-ending press that is marked is certain, the words render correctly for 0/1/many, and the report's figures for this slice check out. Four findings, none of them a blocker for play: (1) a Friday that the clAInk invoice makes certain to end in Collections is not flagged, though the same preview now quotes that invoice (40 of 40 Fridays on the release build, twice); (2) the report's claim that the refused Proposals press is "the one state" where a press buys nothing is false: three more such states are still on offer with a hint that says the press counts; (3) the rent warning presented as certain is not certain when a Proposal/Closing deal is on the board (20 of 160 Fridays on the release build played on); (4) one added test (the Ascension shot count) passes on a broken build. All probes and their outputs are under test-results/review/rules/ ; no tracked file was touched (git status clean).
checked_ok: Frozen 2.1 rules are really 2.1: git tree diff of c7f62f9:src/game and c7f62f9:src/copy against test/baseline/v2.1-engine is empty; all 32 SHA256SUMS entries verify.

Equivalence tool (test/engine/tools/equivalence.mjs): re-run on seeds 5000-5039, 880 of 880 runs the same after every move (37,368 moves), 493 corrected steps. Run unchanged against a private mirror with one mistake planted at a time, it FAILED for: proposeIdle broadened to every empty press (440 of 440 runs), Hail Mary blast stress 4->5 (14 runs), backlog chance 0.18->0.19 (18 runs), clAInk overage 10%->11% (with 150 seeds), run.js guard dropped so the move is offered but refused (2 of 300 novice runs). The 'worthless' check is real: it makes the press on the 2.1 run and rejects any change outside slots/energy/used/log/stress-warning, including a roll. Limits, none a hole: it samples (the offered-but-refused mutant and a 1-point QBR politics change pass at the gate's 20 seeds per policy; the engine tests catch the first); mechanical() ignores a log line's params, words and non-bad kind by design; it drops every `id`, so a waiting choice is compared by its params only, but the next step's legal-move comparison tells choices apart (match/hold vs own/spin). The 220-line log cap its log-growth measure depends on is never reached (longest log in 3,300 runs: 172).

Log text: 1,320 seeded runs played on both engines with the same moves, 108,542 lines compared: only act.network (164 lines, 'It is substantial/a whale') and evt.rebalance (1 line, 'deals') differ; no kind, param or chip text changed.

fatalPress / purchaseBust: 3,000 seeds each on the working tree: Prospect and Politics at 98 stress, conference at 95 stress, conference at -$700, Hail Mary at 96, quad shot at -$1,494 (shot 1 and shot 3) all end the run 3,000 of 3,000; Hail Mary at 95 is not marked and 189 of 3,000 survive. Order of causes (quad shot: heart before bill; conference: bill before stress) matches actions.js/run.js.

fridayPreview.melt: 4,000 of 4,000 seeds end the run at 74 stress with two shots (week 6) and at 87 with one shot in week 13 at 106% of quota; nothing in week.js/events.js lowers stress before the crash.

fridayPreview.claink against billClaink: due when the agents ran, idle range otherwise, null when cancelled/revoked/ad/absent and in week 13; on the release build the previewed $669 is what Friday charged (cash -$300 -> -$1,569).
KPI.ofQuota: every dollar from $0 to $200,000 against a $160,000 quota (and three other quotas): never on the wrong side of 70/80/100, never more than one point from the true share.

Words for 0/1/many: HINT.crm (7 combinations of count, value, nuke), discovery/demo/propose/close/hail at 0, 1, 2, the a/an article for every percentage 0-100, 16 End week variants through the selector (bust before melt, invoice omitted on a fatal Friday, week 13), HINT.ends, CK_AD.policy against the CLAINK constants ($249, $140-$280, two to five, $150-$300, $200-$600, $200-$1,800, $250), CK_STRIKES.hotHead both ways, the three handbook rows against week.js.

Longest hints on the release build (End week with rent + idle invoice + crash; CRM with 10 dead leads worth $956,345 and the manager risk; Hail Mary) are two lines in the bar at 1025, 1100, 1180, 1280 and 1366 wide.

runFacts.shots: no double count: the fatal shot is logged as end.ascension only, in this tree and in the frozen 2.0.1 rules, so +1 on endCause 'caffeine' is right for saves from 2.0 on; a save without a story still reports null.

proposeIdle with a finished run or a waiting choice: blocked() answers 'over' first, refusal() answers 'pending' first; the mark is cleared by the week turning; used.propose/used.close are read by nothing but week.js's didLate.

Engine tests: 120 pass (113 at 2.1). Private mutation run in a mirror, 24 mistakes planted in what 2.1.1 added: 21 caught; 2 of the 3 survivors change nothing reachable (c.due > 0 for c.deployed; value shown without pruned); the third is finding 4. All 58 patterns of mutation-check.py occur exactly once in the sources (52 at 2.1); the script itself was not run.

Report figures for this slice: 23 files under src, +403 -125 (git diff --shortstat); equivalence evidence sums to 1,893,691 moves, 24,190 steps, 10,670 runs; release file sha256 7d4e1e8a... equals dist/index.html; scripts/check-releases.mjs passes and index.html is still 2.1.
Read-only gates run here: engine 120, audio 15, actions gate 104 of 104 on dist/index.html, phone gate 55 of 55 on dist-test/index.html, lint-copy 0 violations, lint-css 0 findings.

findings.title: A Friday whose clAInk invoice is certain to reach Collections is not flagged, although the same preview now quotes that invoice
findings.where: src/game/selectors.js (fridayPreview: `cash` and `bust` are salary and rent only, `claink` is carried beside them and never counted); src/copy/ui.js (HINT.endWeek); src/ui/app/Kpis.jsx (cashSub). Claims: QA report section 1 items 4 and 5 ('A Friday that is certain to end the run says so before End week is pressed'; the invoice 'is as certain as rent'), CHANGELOG 'What a press would buy', release notes line 26.
findings.evidence: Release build dist/index.html (same sha256 as Tech_Sales_Trail_2.1.1.html), probe test-results/review/rules/probe-page.cjs. Week 5, cash -$300, seat ran this week with $669 due: End week's hint reads 'Friday: salary +$1,000, rent -$1,600, clAInk -$669, energy +15, stress -4. Friday events and collections may change this.' and the cash card reads 'Collections at -$1,500 cash' in the warning tone; 40 of 40 Fridays ended in Collections (cause claink, cash -$1,569). Week 9, cash -$750, idle seat (the least idle charge, $150, lands exactly on the line): hint '... clAInk -$150-$300 ...', 40 of 40 Fridays ended in Collections. For contrast, the rent-only case (week 5, cash -$900) reads 'Friday's rent would trigger Collections' and 'That would leave -$1,500 cash. Collections ends the run at -$1,500.' Engine (probe-engine.mjs, 4,000 seeds each): three such states end the run on that Friday 4,000 of 4,000 with bust=false. In simulated play (probe-invoice-sim.mjs, 400 seeds): the `claink` strategy had 9 Fridays where salary, rent and the invoice already due were certain to reach the line (e.g. seed 33, week 2: cash -$1,179, $1,357 due -> -$1,536); all 9 ended in Collections and the flag fired 0 times; `claink-weekly` had 9 more, against 18 Fridays flagged for rent. A code comment scopes bust to 'salary and rent alone', but sections 4 and 5 of the report do not list this.
findings.proposal: In fridayPreview, take the least invoice (c.due when the agents ran, CLAINK.IDLE[0] when idle) off `cash` after rent and flag when that is at or under CASH.repoAt; HINT.endWeek then keeps the clAInk figure and ends with the existing sentence ('That would leave -$1,569 cash. Collections ends the run at -$1,500.'), and the cash card gets a bad-tone line as it does for rent. Add an engine test one dollar either side of the line and a case in the actions gate. If it is left as it is, list it in section 4 and narrow the sentence in item 4, the changelog and the release notes to rent and the coffee crash.

findings.title: The refused Proposals press is not 'the one state where that is literally true': three more states where the press buys nothing are still on offer, with a hint that says it counts
findings.where: src/game/actions.js (proposeIdle); src/copy/ui.js (HINT.propose, count 0); TTST_2.1.1_QA_REPORT.md section 2 ('It is the only action in the game with a state like that'; 'this is the one state where that is literally true'); TTST_2.1.1_RELEASE_NOTES.md lines 20-23.
findings.evidence: Engine probe test-results/review/rules/probe-propose.mjs: the same seeded run is ended with and without one Proposals press on a board with no demoed deal (the press rolls nothing, so Friday draws the same numbers). (a) Week 6 with Prospect, Discovery and Demo already worked: Proposals is a legal move; in 2,000 of 2,000 seeds the two Fridays are identical except energy, slots, the mark and its log line; the full-funnel line is logged 2,000 times without the press and 2,000 with it. (b) Week 13: identical in 2,000 of 2,000 and the run is over in all; with two other categories worked the only difference is a fullFunnel effect dated week 14 on a finished run. (c) Last slot, nothing else worked: identical in 2,000 of 2,000 (neglect either way). Controls (one or two other categories worked, weeks 1-12) differ in 2,000 of 2,000, as the report says. Release build (shot.cjs --state, week 6, used prospect+discovery+demo, slots 2): the card is on and reads 'Proposals 25 energy . no deals', the hint reads 'No eligible deals. You would still spend a slot and energy. It would only count toward a full-funnel week.'; the press is taken (slots 2 -> 1, energy 95 -> 70). Same card and hint in week 13. In simulated play (probe-propose-sim.mjs, 22 strategies x 200 seeds): the refusal applies at 2,427 steps; the press is still on offer in state (a) at 76 steps and in week 13 at 559, in 410 of 4,400 runs.
findings.proposal: Smallest change, no rule touched: correct the three sentences (QA section 2 twice, release notes) to say the refusal covers the week whose proposal-or-close work is already counted, not every press that buys nothing, and give HINT.propose a variant for these states (three other categories already worked: 'This week already counts as full-funnel.'; week 13: there is no next week for it to count toward). The wider option, refusing the press there too, is a second rule change: it needs the owner's decision, a second entry in equivalence.mjs's CORRECTIONS and its own tests.

findings.title: The rent warning is presented as certain when it is not: with a Proposal or Closing deal on the board, a Friday signing pays commission before the rent
findings.where: src/game/selectors.js (fridayPreview.bust; its own comment notes 'a Friday signing pays its commission first'); src/game/week.js (tryCloseSome runs before salaryAndBills); src/copy/ui.js (KPI.rentBust, the bust branch of HINT.endWeek, which also drops 'Friday events and collections may change this'); test/engine/actions.test.mjs (only tested with the first roll at 0.99 and no late deal). Claim: QA report item 4 and CHANGELOG, 'A Friday that is certain to end the run'.
findings.evidence: Release build dist/index.html, week 5, cash -$900, three late deals ($30,000 Closing happy, $22,000 Proposal happy, $18,000 Proposal curious): the cash card reads 'Friday's rent would trigger Collections' and End week's hint 'Friday: salary +$1,000, rent -$1,600. That would leave -$1,500 cash. Collections ends the run at -$1,500.' Of 160 Fridays pressed from that state (each a fresh load), 140 ended in Collections and 20 played on to week 6 (12.5%). Same cash with no late deal: 30 of 30 ended in Collections. Engine, 4,000 seeds (probe-engine.mjs): no late deal 0 survive; one $30,000 Closing deal 212 survive (5.3%); the three late deals 375 survive (9.4%). Impact is small (the warning errs on the safe side), but item 3 holds presses to 'one point or one dollar short of certain, nothing is marked', and this Friday is marked at up to roughly one chance in eight of surviving.
findings.proposal: Keep the warning, and when lateDeals(s).length > 0 say what can still change it (for example append 'unless a deal signs on Friday first' and keep the usual closing sentence), or reserve the bad-tone 'would trigger Collections' wording for boards with no late deal. Change 'certain' in item 4 and the changelog accordingly, and add an engine case with a late deal and a first roll under 0.15 so the caveat is held by a test rather than by a comment.

findings.title: The Ascension shot-count test passes if the extra shot is added to every meltdown
findings.where: test/engine/actions.test.mjs (the two assertions added to the 'Quad shot' test); src/game/selectors.js (runFacts.shots).
findings.evidence: In a private mirror of src and test/engine (test-results/review/rules/mirror, runner mutants.mjs, output mutants-out.txt), replacing `(s.endCause === "caffeine" ? 1 : 0)` with `(s.burnedOut ? 1 : 0)` leaves all 120 engine tests passing. The test checks a run a quad shot ended (+1) and a run still in play (+0); its message says 'adds nothing to a run a quad shot did not end' but no ended run of another kind is tried. With that mistake a stress meltdown's card would count a shot that was never drunk. It is the only one of 24 planted mistakes in the 2.1.1 additions that survived and matters.
findings.proposal: Add two assertions: a run that drank two shots and then ended by stress (for example Prospect blitz at 98 stress) and one that ended in Collections both report exactly the story's count.

verdicts.title: A Friday whose clAInk invoice is certain to reach Collections is not flagged, although the same preview now quotes that invoice
verdicts.why: I tested this on the release build dist/index.html (sha256 7d4e1e8a..., the same file as Tech_Sales_Trail_2.1.1.html) with test-results/review/rules-check/page-probe.cjs, one fresh load per trial. Week 5, cash -$300, seat ran with $669 due, no deals: the cash card reads 'Collections at -$1,500 cash' in the warning tone (class 'sub warn'). End week's hint reads 'Friday: salary +$1,000, rent -$1,600, clAInk -$669, energy +15, stress -4. Friday events and collections may change this.' 21 of 21 Fridays ended in Collections (endCause claink, -$1,569 with no overage). Week 9, cash -$750, idle seat: the hint gives 'clAInk -$150-$300 ... may change this' and 8 of 8 runs ended (7 Collections, 1 fired first). The rent-only control (week 5, -$900) shows 'Friday's rent would trigger Collections' in the bad tone and 'That would leave -$1,500 cash. Collections ends the run at -$1,500.' Engine (engine-probe.mjs, the run's own dice, 2,000 seeds each, fridayPreview.bust false in every case): the week 5 state ended 2,000 of 2,000. Week 9 at -$750 idle: 2,000 of 2,000 ended (379 by firing, which comes first); at -$749, 15 survived. Week 6 (no rent) at -$1,400: with $1,100 due all 2,000 ended; with $1,099 due 1,624 survived. Nothing between rent and the invoice adds cash: events.js has no cash effect, and the Friday close runs first and needs a late deal. So with no Proposal or Closing deal on the board, that Friday is certain to end the run. On the same state, 2.1 showed the same warning-tone card and a hint without the invoice. So this is not a regression, but a claim this diff makes and does not keep: QA item 4 says 'A Friday that is certain to end the run says so before End week is pressed', item 5 calls the invoice 'as certain as rent', and the CHANGELOG and release notes repeat the general sentence. Sections 4 and 5 do not list it; only a code comment narrows bust to 'salary and rent alone'.
verdicts.smallest_fix: Docs only, no rule or copy change: narrow QA section 1 item 4, the CHANGELOG bullet and the release-notes line ('A Friday that would end the run says so...') to the two cases that are flagged (rent that would take cash to the Collections line; a coffee crash that would reach 100). Add a section 4 entry: a Friday whose clAInk invoice (the amount due, or the $150 idle minimum) would take cash to the line is not flagged; the preview shows the invoice and the card shows the line. The code fix is larger: subtract the least invoice (c.deployed ? c.due : CLAINK.IDLE[0]) after rent in fridayPreview for bust; keep the clAInk figure in the bust branch of HINT.endWeek; give the cash card wording that is not about rent; and add tests one dollar either side of the line. With a late deal it would carry the same caveat as finding 3.

verdicts.title: The refused Proposals press is not 'the one state where that is literally true': three more states where the press buys nothing are still on offer, with a hint that says it counts
verdicts.why: Engine probe test-results/review/rules-check/propose-probe.mjs, 1,000 seeds per state. Each seed ends the week as it is (A) and with one Proposals press first (B); the empty press rolls nothing, so both Fridays draw the same numbers. (a) Week 6, Prospect, Discovery and Demo already worked, 2 slots, board of lead, qualified and Proposal deals: Proposals is legal in 1,000 of 1,000. A and B differ only in energy, the log and its wording counter 'said' (plus slots and used on the 135 runs that ended). Full-funnel is logged 1,000 times in A and 1,000 in B, and the effects are identical. (b) Week 13 with nothing else worked: same result, and every run is over (MAX_QUARTERS = 1, so the QBR ends the run). With two other motions worked, the only further difference is a full-funnel effect on a run that is already finished. (c) Last slot, nothing else worked: neglect is logged in 1,000 A and 1,000 B, and the effects are identical. Controls (one or two other motions, last slot) differ in effects in 1,000 of 1,000, as section 2 says. A grep shows used.propose is read only at week.js:40 and by proposeIdle. On the release build (shot.cjs --eval), in (a) and in week 13 the card is on (aria-disabled not set) and reads 'Proposals | 25 energy . no deals'. The hint reads 'No eligible deals. You would still spend a slot and energy. It would only count toward a full-funnel week.' Pressing in (a) is taken: slots 2 to 1, energy 95 to 70, no deal moved. Section 2's own test is 'a mark no rule then reads differently'. By that test, 'It is the only action in the game with a state like that', 'this is the one state where that is literally true' and section 5's 'Narrowed to the state where nothing is left to earn' are false. The owner will read those sentences to judge the one rule change. The new hint sentence misleads in (a) and (b); 2.1's hint was accurate there. The refusal itself is right: it refuses exactly the marked state, and a demoed deal or a new week lifts it. The release-notes wording ('One press that bought nothing is now refused') is not false.
verdicts.smallest_fix: Docs only, rule unchanged: rewrite the two section 2 sentences and the section 5 row to say the refusal covers the week whose proposal-or-close mark is already set. Add to section 4 that an empty Proposals press still buys nothing, and is still offered, when three other motions are already done, in week 13, and on the last slot with no other motion that week. Optional: a HINT.propose variant for those states (new copy). Refusing them too is a second rule change for the owner to decide, with an entry in equivalence.mjs's CORRECTIONS and its own tests.

verdicts.title: The rent warning is presented as certain when it is not: with a Proposal or Closing deal on the board, a Friday signing pays commission before the rent
verdicts.why: Release build dist/index.html, week 5, cash -$900, deals $30,000 Closing (happy), $22,000 Proposal (happy) and $18,000 Proposal (curious). The cash card reads 'Friday's rent would trigger Collections' in the bad tone. End week's hint reads 'Friday: salary +$1,000, rent -$1,600. That would leave -$1,500 cash. Collections ends the run at -$1,500.', without the old 'may change this' sentence. Of 60 Fridays (each a fresh load), 53 ended in Collections and 7 played on to week 6 (11.7%); see test-results/review/rules-check/page-f3.txt. Engine, 2,000 seeds each: with no late deal 2,000 of 2,000 ended in Collections. One $30,000 Closing deal: 108 survived (5.4%). The three late deals: 192 (9.6%). One $5,000 Proposal: 65 (3.3%). The cause: week.js runs the Friday close (rnd < 0.15, tryCloseSome) before salaryAndBills, as fridayPreview's own comment says. The engine test checks the rent case only with the first roll at 0.99. The actions gate's rent checks use an empty board and never press End week, so no gate is dice-dependent here; the case is simply not covered. On the same board, 2.1 showed 'Collections at -$1,500 cash' in the warning tone and the hedged hint, so the unhedged wording and the 'certain' claim are new. QA item 4 and the CHANGELOG list rent as a Friday 'certain to end the run'. With a late deal it is not, so the claim is false; the warning itself errs on the safe side. I confirmed the boundary is right: at -$900 the flag is on, at -$899 it is off.
verdicts.smallest_fix: In QA item 4 and the CHANGELOG, say the rent warning is certain only with no Proposal or Closing deal on the board, since a Friday signing (at most 15% a week) pays commission first; or list that in section 4. If the page is touched, keep the existing sentence 'Friday events and collections may change this.' in the bust branch of HINT.endWeek when lateDeals(s).length > 0 (no new copy). Add an engine case with a late deal and a first roll under 0.15.

verdicts.title: The Ascension shot-count test passes if the extra shot is added to every meltdown
verdicts.why: I built a private mirror of src, test/engine, test/sim, test/saves and test/baseline/checkpoint-engine under test-results/review/rules-check/mirror; the unmutated actions.test.mjs passes 15 of 15 there. With (s.burnedOut ? 1 : 0) in place of (s.endCause === "caffeine" ? 1 : 0) in runFacts, actions.test.mjs still passes 15 of 15. The whole suite reports 'ENGINE TESTS OK: 120 tests passed in 12 files' (mutant-engine-suite.txt). The mutant would be visible to a player: shots-probe.mjs shows a stress meltdown after two shots reading 3 on the card instead of 2, and a meltdown with no shot reading 1. That would show a 'Quad shots' tile and the note '1 quad shot. Facilities is reviewing its supply contract.' for a shot never drunk. A Collections ending is unaffected. No e2e gate covers it either: actions section 10 uses a club ending with n.shots 1, and the phone and matrix gates only measure layout. The test is not vacuous: '+1 always' and '+0' each fail it (14 of 15). The shipped code is correct, and a quad shot that maxes stress is also 'caffeine', so it is counted. This is a coverage gap in a test this diff added, not a defect in the release candidate, not a false statement and not a test that cannot fail.
verdicts.smallest_fix: Add two assertions to the 'Quad shot' test. First: a run that drank two shots and then ended by stress (Prospect blitz at 98, endCause 'stress') gives runFacts(...).shots equal to story.n.shots (2). Second: a Collections ending after a shot gives the story's count. These can go in after the release or be listed.
